text: 金十数据8月14日讯，*ST闻泰公告，2026年上半年营业收入15.14亿元，同比下降94.02%。归属于上市公司股东的净亏损4.06亿元，上年同期净利润4.74亿元，同比转亏。2025年9月30日起，公司下属子公司安世半导体以及安世控股先后收到荷兰经济事务与气候政策部下达的部长令（Order）和阿姆斯特丹上诉法院企业法庭的裁决。截至本报告期末，前述部长令虽已暂停执行，但企业法庭裁决依旧处于生效状态，上市公司对安世境外相关主体的控制权暂处于受限状态。目前，安世境外相关主体已不按照上市公司的指令开展业务，并向安世中国境内相关业务部门暂停晶圆供应，对公司生产
text_en: Jin10 Data, August 14 - *ST Wentai announcement: H1 2026 operating revenue was RMB 1.514 billion, down 94.02% year-on-year. Net loss attributable to shareholders was RMB 406 million, versus net profit of RMB 474 million in the same period last year, turning to a loss. Since September 30, 2025, its subsidiaries Nexperia Semiconductor and Nexperia Holdings have received a ministerial order from the Dutch Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate Policy and a ruling from the Enterprise Court of the Amsterdam Court of Appeal. As of the end of this reporting period, although the ministerial order has been suspended, the enterprise court ruling remains in effect, and the listed company's control over Nexperia's overseas entities is temporarily restricted. Currently, Nexperia's overseas entities no longer conduct business per the listed company's instructions and have suspended wafer supply to Nexperia's domestic China business units, impacting the company's production
